items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Limited by pair of injuries Thursday
items.text:
Jeanty was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice due to ankle and foot injuries, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Status uncertain due to turf toe
items.text:
Monangai is tending to a turf toe injury that's making his status uncertain for the next 1-to-2 weeks, but the running back is aiming to play through it, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
